lead: An illustrated atlas of machine learning. Each concept, from linear regression to Mamba, is drawn as a three-dimensional figure you can turn in your hand, with a plain explanation, real-world uses and working code.
noResults: No concept matches “{q}”. Try an English term or a shorter word.
keys: Use ← and → to move between concepts
footer: Figures are schematic. They are drawn to show how an idea works, not to reproduce exact numbers.
